verdict.rationale: Snyk's marketing page says its context-aware risk scoring weighs 'the reachability of vulnerable code' alongside package popularity and exploit maturity (snyk-docs-36), and the plans page lists risk-based prioritization (snyk-docs-17, snyk-docs-24). Reachability appears only as one input to a blended score, backed by a single thin marketing mention rather than Snyk Open Source documentation. Missing for 10: first-party SCA docs on reachability analysis, a supported-languages list for reachability, the ability to filter or sort dependency alerts specifically by reachable status, call-path evidence linking app code to the vulnerable function, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
